name: Runemaster Nomad's Scroll clears a movement slow when swapping to Runic Tattoos: Air (#3148)
contract: Nomad's Scroll 707653 Effect0 is SPELL_AURA_PROC_TRIGGER_SPELL, ProcChance 100, trigger 712452
(SPELL_EFFECT_DISPEL_MECHANIC, MiscValue 11 = MECHANIC_SNARE, matching 'movement slowing effect'). Spell.dbc's
own ProcFlags (4, PROC_FLAG_KILL) is unrelated to the tooltip and, before the fix, no spell_proc row existed,
so swapping to Runic Tattoos: Air never cleared a snare. Runic Tattoos: Air 802630 is family 38,
SpellFamilyFlags2 32, a positive self-buff, DmgClass magic: at cast phase Spell.cpp sets
PROC_FLAG_DONE_SPELL_MAGIC_DMG_CLASS_POS (0x4000), so the fix scopes the row to that ProcFlags, cast phase,
family 38 mask2 32. Infection 800983 (SPELL_AURA_MOD_DECREASE_SPEED, effect mechanic 11 snare, from
bloodmage-infected-blood-snare.json) is used as the movement-slowing fixture, applied directly so the test
does not depend on any other spell's own proc chain.

steps.label: SETUP: the snare fixture is applied
SETUP: Runic Tattoos: Air is active
SETUP: without the talent, swapping tattoos leaves the snare in place
CONTRACT: swapping to Runic Tattoos: Air clears the snare
